72661-playwrights-on-playmaking.title: Playwrights On Playmaking
72661-playwrights-on-playmaking.creator: Unknown
72661-playwrights-on-playmaking.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. set down here the theories of the theater that I have made my own after half a century of playgoing and of persistent effort to spy out the secrets of stage-craft. To me these theories appear so indisputable and, indeed, so obvious that I am ever surprized when I chance to see them challenged. They are not many, and they can be declared briefly.

arxiv-1312-6286.title: Description of the lack of compactness in Orlicz spaces and applications
arxiv-1312-6286.creator: Ines Ben Ayed, Mohamed Khalil Zghal
arxiv-1312-6286.description: A 2013 arXiv research paper by Ines Ben Ayed, Mohamed Khalil Zghal. In this paper, we investigate the lack of compactness of the Sobolev embedding of H 1 ​ ( ℝ 2 ) H^{1}(\mathbb{R}^{2}) into the Orlicz space L ϕ p ​ ( ℝ 2 ) L^{{\phi}_{p}}(\mathbb{R}^{2}) associated to the function ϕ p \phi_{p} defined by ϕ p ( s ) := e s 2 − ∑ k = 0 p − 1 s 2 ​ k k !

arxiv-1907-09272.title: Extending the ARC Information Providers to report information on GPU resources
arxiv-1907-09272.creator: Max Isacson, Mattias Ellert, Richard Brenner
arxiv-1907-09272.description: Abstract 1 Introduction General-purpose Computing on Graphics Processing Units (GPGPU) has been introduced to many areas of scientific research such as bioinformatics [ 1 ] , cryptography [ 2 ] , computer vision [ 3 ] , and deep learning [ 4 ] .

arxiv-2112-09617.title: Exact and Approximate Counting of Database Repairs
arxiv-2112-09617.creator: Marco Calautti, Ester Livshits, Andreas Pieris, Markus Schneider, [2mm] Department of Computer Science, University of Milan
arxiv-2112-09617.description: Abstract Database integrity constraints allow us to specify semantic properties that should be satisfied by all databases of a certain relational schema. However, real-life databases are often inconsistent, i.e., do not conform to their specifications in the form of integrity constraints.

arxiv-2210-08534.title: Rainbow powers of a Hamilton cycle in G n , p G_{n,p}
arxiv-2210-08534.creator: Tolson Bell and Alan Frieze
arxiv-2210-08534.description: Abstract We show that the threshold for having a rainbow copy of a power of a Hamilton cycle in a randomly edge colored copy of G n , p G_{n,p} is within a constant factor of the uncolored threshold. Our proof requires ( 1 + ε ) (1+\varepsilon) times the minimum number of colors.

arxiv-2304-03601.title: Permutation Invariant Encodings for Quantum Machine Learning with Point Cloud Data
arxiv-2304-03601.creator: Jamie Heredge, Charles Hill, Lloyd Hollenberg, Martin Sevior
arxiv-2304-03601.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jamie Heredge, Charles Hill, Lloyd Hollenberg, Martin Sevior. Quantum Computing offers a potentially powerful new method for performing Machine Learning. However, several Quantum Machine Learning techniques have been shown to exhibit poor generalisation as the number of qubits increases huang_power_2021 . We address this issue by demonstrating a permutation invariant quantum encoding method, which exhibits superior generalisation performance, and apply it to point cloud data (three-dimensional images composed of points).

arxiv-2406-16080.title: Spectral properties of Cayley graphs over finite commutative rings
arxiv-2406-16080.creator: Priya, Sanjay Kumar Singh
arxiv-2406-16080.description: Abstract Abstract Let R be a finite commutative ring with unity and x be a non-zero element of R . In this paper, we calculate the spectrum and energy of the Cayley graph {\rm Cay}(R,xR^{*}) , and also compute the energy of their compliment graph. Further, we give necessary and sufficient condition for Cayley graph {\rm Cay}(R,xR^{*}) to be Ramanujan.

arxiv-2412-01036.title: Generating Freeform Endoskeletal Robots
arxiv-2412-01036.creator: Muhan Li, Lingji Kong, Sam Kriegman
arxiv-2412-01036.description: Abstract The automatic design of embodied agents (e.g. robots) has existed for 31 years and is experiencing a renaissance of interest in the literature. To date however, the field has remained narrowly focused on two kinds of anatomically simple robots: (1) fully rigid, jointed bodies; and (2) fully soft, jointless bodies.

arxiv-2501-10862.title: Symmetries and Anomalies of Hamiltonian Staggered Fermions
arxiv-2501-10862.creator: Simon Catterall, Arnab Pradhan, Abhishek Samlodia
arxiv-2501-10862.description: Abstract We review the shift (translation) and time reversal symmetries of Hamiltonian staggered fermions and their connection to continuum symmetries concentrating in particular on the case of massless fermions and (3+1) dimensions. We construct operators using the staggered fields that implement these symmetries on finite lattices.

arxiv-2502-12719.title: A Numerical Investigation of Particle Deposition on a Substrate
arxiv-2502-12719.creator: Ananta KumarNayak, AmritpalSingh, Mehrdad Mesgarpour, Mostafa SafdariShadloo
arxiv-2502-12719.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ananta KumarNayak, AmritpalSingh, Mehrdad Mesgarpour, Mostafa SafdariShadloo. The deposition of nanometer-scale particles is of significant interest in various industrial processes. While these particles offer several advantages, their deposition can have detrimental effects, such as reducing the heat transfer efficiency in nanofluid-based battery cooling systems. In this study, we investigated particle deposition around different square substrate configurations as well as experimentally obtained complex porous structure in a two-dimensional setup.

arxiv-2502-17433.title: Dynamical phases of short-term memory mechanisms in RNNs
arxiv-2502-17433.creator: Bariscan Kurtkaya *, Fatih Dinc *, Mert Yuksekgonul, Marta Blanco-Pozo, Ege Cirakman, Mark Schnitzer, Yucel Yemez, Hidenori Tanaka †, Peng Yuan †, Nina Miolane †
arxiv-2502-17433.description: Abstract Short-term memory is essential for cognitive processing, yet our understanding of its neural mechanisms remains unclear. Neuroscience has long focused on how sequential activity patterns, where neurons fire one after another within large networks, can explain how information is maintained. While recurrent connections were shown to drive sequential dynamics, a mechanistic understanding of this process still remains unknown.

arxiv-2602-11308.title: Partial conservation of seniority in semi-magic nuclei Journal: Eur. Phys. J. A
arxiv-2602-11308.creator: Chong Qi addr1
arxiv-2602-11308.description: Abstract The concept of seniority plays a central role in nuclear structure physics by classifying many-body states according to the number of unpaired nucleons. While exact seniority conservation holds in single- j j systems with j ≤ 7 / 2 j\leq 7/2 , deviations arise for higher- j j orbitals where residual interactions can mix states of different seniority.

pmc-10565678.title: Fibrin microthrombi in bladder urothelium after SARS-CoV-2 infection: Case report
pmc-10565678.creator: Ly Hoang Roberts, Bernadette M.M. Zwaans, Kausar Jabbar, Sarah N. Bartolone, Priya Padmanabhan, Kenneth M. Peters
pmc-10565678.description: A 45-year-old male with diabetes, hypertension and hyperlipidemia was referred to urology due to persistent symptoms of urinary frequency, urgency, nocturia, erectile dysfunction, and constant pain localized to the bladder, pelvis, and perineal area, 3–4 months after SARS-CoV-2 infection. A bladder biopsy showed urothelial mucosa and submucosa with hemorrhage and fibrin microthrombi in blood vessels.

pmc-11475729.title: Interdisciplinary Animal Research Ethics—Challenges, Opportunities, and Perspectives
pmc-11475729.creator: Marcel Mertz, Tatiana Hetzel, Karla Alex, Katharina Braun, Samuel Camenzind, Rita Dodaro, Svea Jörgensen, Erich Linder, Sara Capas-Peneda, Eva Ingeborg Reihs, Vini Tiwari, Zorana Todorović, Hannes Kahrass, Felicitas Selter, Steven P McCulloch
pmc-11475729.description: Simple SummaryAre we morally justified in using animals in biomedical research and if so, how can we make sure that the experiments are conducted in a scientifically and morally acceptable manner? Based on our own experiences as scholars from various academic backgrounds, we argue that this question can only be answered as an interdisciplinary and international endeavor.

pmc-11585628.title: Discovery of orally bioavailable SARS-CoV-2 papain-like protease inhibitor as a potential treatment for COVID-19
pmc-11585628.creator: Yongzhi Lu, Qi Yang, Ting Ran, Guihua Zhang, Wenqi Li, Peiqi Zhou, Jielin Tang, Minxian Dai, Jinpeng Zhong, Hua Chen, Pan He, Anqi Zhou, Bao Xue, Jiayi Chen, Jiyun Zhang, Sidi Yang, Kunzhong Wu, Xinyu Wu, Miru Tang, Wei K Zhang, Deyin Guo, Xinwen Chen, Hongming Chen, Jinsai Shang
pmc-11585628.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), 3C-like protease (3CLpro), and papain-like protease (PLpro) are pivotal components in the viral life cycle of SARS-CoV-2, presenting as promising therapeutic targets. Currently, all FDA-approved antiviral drugs against SARS-CoV-2 are RdRp or 3CLpro inhibitors. However, the mutations causing drug resistance have been observed in RdRp and 3CLpro from SARS-CoV-2, which makes it necessary to develop antivirals with novel mechanisms.

pmc-11675176.title: Carnot and the Archetype of Waterfalls
pmc-11675176.creator: Hans U. Fuchs, Elisabeth Dumont, Federico Corni
pmc-11675176.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Carnot treats Heat as a Force of Nature, with its typical fundamental characteristics of intensity and thermal tension (temperature and temperature difference), extension (amount of heat, i.e., caloric), and power. To suggest how the three aspects are related, he applies the imagery of waterfalls to causative thermal processes: heat powers motion in a heat engine just as falling water does when activating rotation in a water wheel.

pmc-12458635.title: ‘Fast Ossifier’ in diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis: a sex-modulated, heterogeneous phenotype with accelerated ossification and early trabecular decline
pmc-12458635.creator: Emilio Pariente-Rodrigo, Marta Martín-Millán, Giusi Sgaramella, Javier Pardo-Lledías, Patricia Fierro-Andrés, Merelyn Bonome, Sandra Solares, Carmen Ramos-Barrón, José Manuel Olmos-Martínez, Victor Martínez-Taboada, José L Hernández
pmc-12458635.description: BackgroundDiffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis (DISH) is considered a slowly progressive condition, typically requiring a decade to achieve full radiographic development. However, some individuals exhibit accelerated ossification. This study aimed to characterise the clinical profile of these patients, referred to as Fast Ossifiers (FO).

pmc-12596425.title: Dual-modal ultrasound-based deep learning radiomics for differentiation of benign and malignant breast lesions
pmc-12596425.creator: Juntao Shen, Gongquan Chen, Haimei Lun, Huafang Huang, Ling Zhang, Lingling Li, Yunxia Deng, Yinyu Zhang, Guilian Zhang, Qiao Hu
pmc-12596425.description: BackgroundBreast cancer (BC) is the most prevalent malignancy among women worldwide. The development of accurate and noninvasive diagnostic methods is essential to reduce unnecessary biopsies and surgeries. This study aims to develop a dual-modal deep learning (DL) radiomics model based on B-mode ultrasound (BUS) and contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) images.

pmc-12801945.title: Experiences of wound, ostomy and continence nurses after the earthquake in Türkiye: a phenomenological study
pmc-12801945.creator: Dilek Aktaş, Burçin Irmak, Sinan Aydoğan, Zehra Göçmen Baykara
pmc-12801945.description: BackgroundGiven the earthquake-related injuries, particular needs of patients with chronic wounds and ostomy, Wound, Ostomy, and Continence Nurses (WOCNs) who care for disaster victims play critical roles in this extraordinary process.ObjectiveTo explore and identify the experiences of the WOCNs who work in the provinces affected by the Kahramanmaraş and Hatay earthquakes in 2023.

pmc-13199652.title: Sequential Yttrium-90 radioembolization integrated with multimodal therapy for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer liver metastases
pmc-13199652.creator: Anne Wahl, Jacob Fryer, Courtney Vazquez, Scott Kim, James Mega, Emily Penick
pmc-13199652.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights•Sequential yttrium-90 radioembolization used for ovarian liver metastases.•Demonstrates feasibility of repeated liver-directed therapy.•Integrated with systemic therapy, surgery, and nodal radiation.•Maintained hepatic control while preserving functional liver reserve.•Achieved durable disease control beyond two years.Keywords: Case report, yttrium-90 (Y-90) radioembolization, Locoregional therapy, Ovarian cancer, Platinum-resistant Introduction Ovarian cancer is a leading cause of gynecologic cancer mortality and is frequently diagnosed at an advanced stage (Webb & Jordan, 2024).

pmc-13599281.title: Real-world operational characteristics of perovskite photovoltaics
pmc-13599281.creator: Xingtao Wang, Chi Zhang, Congbo Shi, Chuanke Chen, Lichuang Wang, Zizhen Lin, Chao Dong, Dongming Zhao
pmc-13599281.description: Perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have achieved remarkable progress in power conversion efficiency, approaching 27% for single-junction device. As this photovoltaic technology advances toward industrial implementation, operational characteristics are becoming increasing critical. Although considerable efforts have been devoted to studying stability under laboratory conditions, the operational characteristics of PSCs in real-world differ markedly and remain insufficiently explored.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) All duties, powers, and functions of the Interstate Commerce Commission under sections 9 to 15 of this title, relating to operation of telegraph lines by railroad and telegraph companies granted Government aid in the construction of their lines, are imposed.
